ops.d: List every deployments in the subscription.
List the deployments in a resource group.

features.t: Resource groups (create, get, list, delete) over ARM
Resources (every resource type inside the group, at once)
Resource locks (Microsoft.Authorization/locks), scoped to the resource group itself

x: Every resource listed in properties.template.resources is actually created (a real PUT through the same ARM dispatcher, with [parameters('x')] / [variables('y')] resolved to literal values) — but there is no full template-language evaluation: no concat()/resourceId()/reference()/copy-loop support, and dependsOn is not topologically sorted (resources are provisioned in template order). Redeploy re-runs the stored template for real; Cancel honestly 409s, since every deployment here completes synchronously and is never still 'Running' by the time a Cancel call could reach it.
Only console/SDK-triggered mutations made since the simulation booted are recorded (no historical backfill), and `caller` is a fixed placeholder identity rather than a real signed-in principal.

features.t: Access control (IAM) — role assignments, roles and checkAccess
x: Role assignments are real ARM resources scoped to the resource group they were created under (list + checkAccess only see assignments at or above that scope, same hierarchy inheritance and explicit-deny-wins semantics as the Entra RBAC engine), and the Roles tab + checkAccess cover the built-in Owner/Contributor/Reader/… roles plus any custom role definitions. But checkAccess is a standalone decision tool: no other ARM call in Vyomi consults it, so every other data-plane/control-plane operation still succeeds regardless of what is assigned. Deny assignments and classic administrators are always empty.

features.t: Cost analysis, budgets and cost alerts, scoped to this resource group

x: A stack evaluates its ARM template through the same bounded template engine as a plain deployment and OWNS the resources it provisions: deleting the stack deletes them (or detaches them with unmanageAction.Resources=detach), and denySettings.mode denyDelete / denyWriteAndDelete really blocks a direct delete (and write) of a managed resource with 403 DenyAssignmentAuthorizationFailed.

features.t: Creating a new resource from the Marketplace (Vyomi Marketplace)
x: Vyomi publishes its own SaaS-simulator offers; subscribing creates a real Microsoft.SaaS/resources resource in this resource group. The third-party vendors' APIs are not emulated and nothing is billed.
